title: Polish loop convergence-impossible runaway — row #48 referrals artifact, 18 effective rounds, $61.44 total

intake_metadata.summary: Polish loop on row #48 (Anthropic Engineering Editorial Lead) ran ~3.9 hours wall-clock, $61.44 across 6 artifacts with the referrals artifact alone consuming 18 effective inner rounds (3 outer × 6 inner) due to adversarial.passes hedging false with zero blocking findings. Resolved in PR #194: POLISH_MAX_ROUNDS=6 hard total-rounds cap + POLISH_COST_WARN_USD=5 warn threshold + incremental polish-orchestrator-summary.json writes + SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers + 56-check smoke test suite (zero LLM API calls). New bug-class entry added at AGENTS.md generalizes the safe pattern to all iterative loops with non-deterministic quality thresholds.

title: dashboard-server.mjs may not render new career-ops-health panel without rebuild + restart

intake_metadata.summary: Shipped data/dashboard-panels/career-ops-health.json + agent that writes it. Dashboard build-dashboard.mjs may not have a widget reading this panel yet. After deploy: rebuild dashboard + restart dashboard-server, then verify a 'System health' or career-ops-health widget renders. If no widget exists, add one that reads the panel + surfaces severity_tally + freshness_score + cost_drift_band.

title: career-ops-health.mjs silently degrades if dotenv module is missing from node_modules

intake_metadata.summary: The dynamic import of dotenv in career-ops-health.mjs is wrapped in try/catch that swallows ENOENT. If node_modules/dotenv is missing in a future install, env-shadow returns silently — ANTHROPIC_API_KEY would read as '' and synthesis would skip without explanation. Hardening: log a stderr warning when the catch fires.

title: career-ops-health plist symlink — repo edits require manual launchctl bootout+bootstrap

intake_metadata.summary: Bootstrap symlinks ~/Library/LaunchAgents/<plist> -> scripts/launchd/<plist>. Editing the file in scripts/launchd/ does NOT auto-reload — launchd caches the plist contents at bootstrap time. Hardening: document the bootout+bootstrap cycle in the agent's SKILL.md AND in AGENTS.md alongside the symlink pattern.

title: Anthropic-dependent agents (career-ops-health, regression-guard, polish-loop, intel-refresh) silently degrade until credits topped up

intake_metadata.summary: HTTP 400 'Your credit balance is too low' from console.anthropic.com observed during career-ops-health --scheduled. Every agent that uses Anthropic API will degrade similarly: regression-guard Sonnet synthesis (--deep mode), bug-resolver adjudicate/verify phases, polish-loop, intel-refresh hm-intel + positioning, /deploy-verify Phase 9 synthesis. The 11 plists with non-zero last-exit codes Phase 5 surfaced are likely correlated. Mitchell must top up at console.anthropic.com → Plans & Billing. No code fix possible — surface as needs_human.

title: /deploy-verify skill references inline prompt at fixed dated path — if moved/renamed, skill breaks silently

intake_metadata.summary: The /deploy-verify skill at .claude/skills/deploy-verify/SKILL.md references data/deploy-verify-prompt-2026-05-25.md as the canonical inline prompt. If a future deploy renames the prompt with a newer date (e.g., 2026-06-01), the skill will reference a non-existent file. Hardening: either symlink data/deploy-verify-prompt.md -> latest version, OR have the skill grep for the most recent data/deploy-verify-prompt-*.md.
